name: turns-val-c
what: the clean reproduction of R's recipe on her round-1 labels (r-recipe, its adapter in the bucket once its train stage has ended on NODE-recipe), the final checkpoints of the 1- and 2-user DAgger rows (dagger-u1-lag1's and dagger-u2-lag1's phase 199) and dagger-u4-lag1's phase 135, whose reasoning ballooned as its score fell, on R's 100 validation puzzles under the turn-based budget (40 model calls an action, 6 a follow-up, no seconds), where the serving sets only how long a play takes, never its score (the author, 25 Oct 2026): the key models of the generalisation search validated again, so that every gap between them is read without the clock
